title: Material Laser
body:
"Assign a material to the laser by touching the material onto the schematic input. When the laser hits a material, it will output a signal of 10.0"

The Material Laser is a logic component that can be purchased from Alan's AutoLogistics for $1,800. It projects a constant blue laser that extends about 40 studs. A material filter can be applied to the Material Laser by touching the small rectangular schematic-like piece to the left of its wire spot. If the laser hits the material its filter is set to, it will output a signal of 10.0. So long as the laser is hitting the material, it will output a continuous signal, but once the material comes out of contact with the laser, the signal will break off.
